<template>
  <NavbarComponent></NavbarComponent>

        <!-- <router-link class="hover:text-cyan-500 transition-colors" to="/">Home </router-link>

        <router-link class="hover:text-cyan-500 transition-colors" to="/about">About </router-link> -->

  <router-view/>
</template>
<script>
import firebase from 'firebase';
  import NavbarComponent from "@/components/Navbar.vue";
  import FooterComponent from "@/components/Footer.vue";
  export default {
    name: "landing-page",
    components: {
      NavbarComponent,
      FooterComponent
    },

    beforeRouteEnter(to,from,next) {

    next(vm=>{
    firebase.auth().onAuthStateChanged(user=>{
      if(user){
        next();
      }else{
        vm.$router.push('/login')
      }
    })
})
}
  }
  </script>
